target.description: When and why the established hot flame of a burner-stabilised spherical flame ends: cumulative incidence of self-extinction and of flow termination by the operator or the script, as a partition with the flame still active.
excludes: cool flames after the hot flame (the PSI-159 burn time of a self-extinguished test ends with the hot flame)
a causal effect of an operator action: the stops are the observed campaign policy
a calibrated posterior: the spread is an assumed clock distribution

features.name: c_logm
features.transform: ln(x / norm.mdot_ref_kg_s); x is the injected FUEL mass flow (setpoint, not a post-hoc burn rate) @1

features.name: c_o2
features.transform: (x - norm.o2_ref) / norm.o2_scale; x is the O2 mole fraction of the AMBIENT (chamber) gas @1

features.name: c_xf
features.transform: ln(x / norm.xf_ref); x is the fuel mole fraction of the INJECTED stream @1

features.name: b_rss
features.transform: ln(r_ss / norm.r_ref_mm), r_ss = m_tot / (4 pi rhoD L) in mm with rhoD = se.rho_d_g_m_s; burner feature 0 @1

features.name: b_mtot
features.transform: ln(m_tot / norm.mtot_ref_kg_s), m_tot = injected_mass_flow / Y_R; burner feature 1 @1

tensors.name: se.flux.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the critical burner-side reactant mass flux at radiative extinction, ln(m_cr / 1 g m-2 s-1); row j reads c in feature order.

tensors.name: se.flux.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the critical burner-side reactant mass flux at radiative extinction, ln(m_cr / 1 g m-2 s-1) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: se.flux.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the critical burner-side reactant mass flux at radiative extinction, ln(m_cr / 1 g m-2 s-1).

tensors.name: se.flux.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the critical burner-side reactant mass flux at radiative extinction, ln(m_cr / 1 g m-2 s-1) in c; every element is stated.

tensors.name: se.flux.b0
tensors.description: Value of the critical burner-side reactant mass flux at radiative extinction, ln(m_cr / 1 g m-2 s-1) at c = 0 before hinge terms.

tensors.name: se.diff.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the effective diffusivity of the flame-growth clock, ln(D / 1 mm2 s-1); row j reads c in feature order.

tensors.name: se.diff.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the effective diffusivity of the flame-growth clock, ln(D / 1 mm2 s-1) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: se.diff.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the effective diffusivity of the flame-growth clock, ln(D / 1 mm2 s-1).

tensors.name: se.diff.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the effective diffusivity of the flame-growth clock, ln(D / 1 mm2 s-1) in c; every element is stated.

tensors.name: se.diff.b0
tensors.description: Value of the effective diffusivity of the flame-growth clock, ln(D / 1 mm2 s-1) at c = 0 before hinge terms.

tensors.name: se.flash.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the weak-flame class logit; row j reads c in feature order.

tensors.name: se.flash.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the weak-flame class logit (hinge positions).

tensors.name: se.flash.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the weak-flame class logit.

tensors.name: se.flash.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the weak-flame class logit in c; every element is stated.

tensors.name: se.flash.b0
tensors.description: Value of the weak-flame class logit at c = 0 before hinge terms.

tensors.name: se.osc.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the median of the oscillation and quench clock after the floor, ln(tau_osc / 1 s); row j reads c in feature order.

tensors.name: se.osc.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the median of the oscillation and quench clock after the floor, ln(tau_osc / 1 s) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: se.osc.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the median of the oscillation and quench clock after the floor, ln(tau_osc / 1 s).

tensors.name: se.osc.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the median of the oscillation and quench clock after the floor, ln(tau_osc / 1 s) in c; every element is stated.

tensors.name: se.osc.b0
tensors.description: Value of the median of the oscillation and quench clock after the floor, ln(tau_osc / 1 s) at c = 0 before hinge terms.

tensors.name: bt.rise.W1
tensors.description: Hidden weights of the equilibrium temperature rise of the burner, ln(dT_eq / 1 K); row j reads b in feature order.

tensors.name: bt.rise.b1
tensors.description: Hidden biases of the equilibrium temperature rise of the burner, ln(dT_eq / 1 K) (hinge positions).

tensors.name: bt.rise.w2
tensors.description: Output weights of the equilibrium temperature rise of the burner, ln(dT_eq / 1 K).

tensors.name: bt.rise.skip
tensors.description: Linear part of the equilibrium temperature rise of the burner, ln(dT_eq / 1 K) in b; every element is stated.

tensors.name: bt.rise.b0
tensors.description: Value of the equilibrium temperature rise of the burner, ln(dT_eq / 1 K) at b = 0 before hinge terms.

tensors.name: se.rho_d_g_m_s
tensors.description: rhoD of the quasi-steady flame radius r_ss = m_tot / (4 pi rhoD L); also enters b_rss.

tensors.name: se.sigma_phi
tensors.description: sd of ln Phi: how well the reduced flow of a test is known.

tensors.name: se.hold_log_rate
tensors.description: ln of the constant self-extinction hazard of an established flame after the floor; -40 switches it off.

tensors.name: se.floor_s
tensors.description: Time after ignition before which the main class cannot self-extinguish (flame establishment).

tensors.name: se.shape
tensors.description: Log-logistic shape of the growth clock at a given Phi (sd of ln R = pi / (shape sqrt 3)).

tensors.name: se.osc_shape
tensors.description: Log-logistic shape of the oscillation and quench clock.

tensors.name: se.flash_tau_s
tensors.description: Median life of a weak flame.

tensors.name: se.flash_shape
tensors.description: Log-logistic shape of the weak-flame clock.

tensors.name: bt.tau_s
tensors.description: Heating time constant of the burner: T_b(t) = t0 + dT (1 - exp(-t / tau)).

tensors.name: bt.t0_c
tensors.description: Burner temperature at ignition.

tensors.name: bt.sigma
tensors.description: sd of ln dT_eq over num.bt_nodes equally likely heating nodes.

tensors.name: bt.shape
tensors.description: Log-logistic shape of the limit time around each (heating node, limit) pair's time.

tensors.name: bt.limit_c
tensors.description: Burner temperature limit settings of the campaign.

tensors.name: bt.limit_w
tensors.description: Weights of the limit settings, normalised by their sum; all zero switches the burner-heating clock off.

tensors.name: ft.atom_t_s
tensors.description: Times of programmed stops (script durations and time-outs), seconds since the time origin.

tensors.name: ft.atom_logit
tensors.description: Logit of the probability that a flame burning at ft.atom_t_s[a] is stopped there, at c = 0; -40 switches an atom off.

tensors.name: ft.atom_w
tensors.description: Condition dependence of each programmed-stop logit; row a reads c in feature order.

tensors.name: ft.log_base
tensors.description: ln of the constant background hazard of an operator stop.

tensors.name: norm.p_ref_pa
tensors.description: Reference pressure of c_logp.

tensors.name: norm.mdot_ref_kg_s
tensors.description: Reference injected mass flow of c_logm.

tensors.name: norm.o2_ref
tensors.description: Reference O2 mole fraction of c_o2.

tensors.name: norm.o2_scale
tensors.description: Scale of c_o2.

tensors.name: norm.xf_ref
tensors.description: Reference fuel mole fraction of c_xf.

tensors.name: norm.tad_ref_k
tensors.description: Reference adiabatic flame temperature of c_tad.

tensors.name: norm.tad_scale_k
tensors.description: Scale of c_tad.

tensors.name: norm.zst_ref
tensors.description: Reference stoichiometric mixture fraction of c_zst.

tensors.name: norm.zst_scale
tensors.description: Scale of c_zst.

tensors.name: norm.r_ref_mm
tensors.description: Reference quasi-steady radius of b_rss.

tensors.name: norm.mtot_ref_kg_s
tensors.description: Reference burner-stream mass flow of b_mtot.

tensors.name: phys.mw_ethane
tensors.description: Molar mass of ethane.

tensors.name: phys.mw_propane
tensors.description: Molar mass of propane.

tensors.name: phys.mw_butane
tensors.description: Molar mass of n-butane.

tensors.name: phys.mw_n2
tensors.description: Molar mass of nitrogen, the diluent of both streams.

tensors.name: phys.mw_o2
tensors.description: Molar mass of oxygen.

tensors.name: num.phi_nodes
tensors.description: Equally likely values of ln Phi the main class is integrated over (standard-normal quantiles at (i + 1/2) / n).

tensors.name: num.bt_nodes
tensors.description: Equally likely values of ln dT_eq the burner-heating clock is integrated over (standard-normal quantiles at (j + 1/2) / n).

tensors.name: num.tau_cap_s
tensors.description: Largest growth-clock median; a longer one is a held flame for every purpose of the horizon.

tensors.name: num.atom_half_s
tensors.description: Half-width over which a programmed stop is spread (burn times are recorded to the second).

tensors.name: num.dt_s
tensors.description: Largest integration step.

tensors.name: num.horizon_s
tensors.description: Model horizon since the time origin.

notes: No time series enters: conditions, cutoff and control stages known at the cutoff only. Burner-side quantities: the reactant mass fraction Y_R of the injected stream from its mole fraction and the phys.mw_* constants (fuel in N2 for normal flames, O2 in N2 for inverse); injected_mass_flow is the reactant alone in both configurations (PSI-159 mHC, and O2 flow rate), so m_R = injected_mass_flow and m_tot = m_R / Y_R; normal: L = ln(1 / (1 - zst)); inverse: L = ln(1 / zst). r_ss = m_tot / (4 pi rhoD L), r_ext = sqrt(m_R / (4 pi m_cr)), Phi = (r_ss / r_ext)^2, m_cr = exp(N_flux(c)) g m-2 s-1, D = exp(N_diff(c)) mm2/s, t_g = r_ext^2 / (4 D); growth clock of node i (z_i the standard-normal quantile at (i + 1/2) / num.phi_nodes, ln Phi_i = ln Phi + sigma_phi z_i): R_i = t_g / erfcinv(Phi_i^-1/2)^2 when Phi_i > 1 and R_i < num.tau_cap_s, else none; erfcinv(y) = -normal_quantile(y / 2) / sqrt(2). Self-extinction survival from the time origin, t' = max(t - se.floor_s, 0): S_w(t) = 1 / (1 + (t / se.flash_tau_s)^se.flash_shape); S_i(t) = [1 / (1 + (t' / R_i)^se.shape), or 1 without a growth clock] x 1 / (1 + (t' / exp(N_osc(c)))^se.osc_shape) x exp(-exp(se.hold_log_rate) t'); S_se = p_weak S_w + sum_i ((1 - p_weak) / num.phi_nodes) S_i, p_weak = sigmoid(N_flash(c)). Burner limit: b = (b_rss, b_mtot, c_tad, c_xf, c_logp, f_ethane, f_butane); ln dT_j = N_rise(b) + bt.sigma z_j (z_j at (j + 1/2) / num.bt_nodes); for each limit l with bt.limit_w[l] > 0: t_jl = -bt.tau_s ln(1 - (bt.limit_c[l] - bt.t0_c) / dT_j) when dT_j > bt.limit_c[l] - bt.t0_c, else never; S_bt = sum_jl (bt.limit_w[l] / sum bt.limit_w) / num.bt_nodes x [1 / (1 + (t / t_jl)^bt.shape), or 1 when never]; all weights zero: S_bt = 1; a weighted limit at or below bt.t0_c is a refusal. Stops: S_ps = exp(-exp(ft.log_base) t) prod_a (1 - p_a)^clamp((t - (T_a - num.atom_half_s)) / (2 num.atom_half_s), 0, 1), p_a = sigmoid(ft.atom_logit[a] + ft.atom_w[a, :] . c), atoms with T_a = 0 or p_a <= 1e-9 off. From the cutoff, on a grid with step <= num.dt_s up to each requested time: rho_f = S_f(b) / S_f(a) for f = se, bt, ps; lost = S (1 - rho_se rho_bt rho_ps), S = 1 at the cutoff; the lost mass goes to extinction and operator termination in proportion to -ln rho_se and -(ln rho_bt + ln rho_ps), so the four rows sum to one exactly. p_weak_at_cutoff = p_weak S_w(cutoff) / S_se(cutoff); p_held_at_cutoff = the same ratio summed over the nodes with no growth clock. A survival of zero at the cutoff is a refusal. A fuel indicator other than 0 or 1, or two of them set, is a refusal. A clock that is not finite and positive at the conditions (an overflow of a law network) is a refusal. A stop known at the cutoff (control `scheduled_stop`, `flow_stop`, or an operator action starting `MFCs off`) at or before the cutoff refuses the forecast; a later one moves the mass still active at that time to operator_termination. Beyond num.horizon_s the mass still active is unresolved_support. Uncertainty kind: assumed_noise.
